question: Where are a café situated within 70 kilometers when moving north from Rockford Career College, Rockford, IL?
sql: SELECT p.poi_name, p.addr_state, p.addr_city FROM pois AS p, ( SELECT geometry AS college_geom FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Rockford Career College%' LIMIT 1 ) AS college WHERE p.amenity = 'cafe' AND ST_DWithin(p.geometry::geography, college.college_geom::geography, 70000) AND ST_Y(ST_Centroid(p.geometry)) > ST_Y(ST_Centroid(college.college_geom)) ORDER BY ST_Distance(p.geometry::geography, college.college_geom::geography) ASC;
